Back in those days, we had Jesse. What Jesse name? He got killed in Walter Barnes. What is his name? He got born up Jesse's. Him. I can't remember. We had Porter. Porter was about the greatest here. Eugene Porter. Eugene Porter. Eugene Porter. He was about the greatest clarinet player that I ever heard in my life. Yeah.
